functions.name: central
functions.description: Federated C-statistic (concordance statistic / AUC) measuring how well a numeric score discriminates a binary outcome across multiple organizations without sharing raw data.

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: List of organization IDs to include in the computation.

arguments.name: outcome_col
arguments.description: Binary column defining the event / non-event outcome.

arguments.name: columns
arguments.description: List of numeric score columns to evaluate, one C-statistic each. If None, all numeric columns (other than outcome_col) are used.

arguments.name: positive_label
arguments.description: The value of outcome_col that denotes the event/positive outcome. Required unless the column is boolean or coded {0, 1}.

arguments.name: alpha
arguments.description: Significance level for the confidence interval, e.g. 0.05 for a 95% CI.
